name: vegeta
description_en: HTTP load testing tool and library. It's over 9000!
readme_excerpt: Vegeta Vegeta is a versatile HTTP load testing tool built out of a need to drill HTTP services with a constant request rate. It's over 9000! Features - Usable as a command line tool and a Go library. - CLI designed with UNIX composability in mind. - Avoids nasty Coordinated Omission. - Extensive reporting functionality. - Simple to use for distributed load testing. - Easy to install and run (static binary, package managers, etc).
